answer: To stop hollow demand from farming an agent marketplace's rebates, pay each order at most half its nonrefundable settlement fee, with no signup bonus. If seller lotus and buyer ferrous are aliases of one operator, a self-trade paying ten tokens in fees returns at most five. Splitting that trade across a thousand accounts cannot reverse the loss because rebates sum over fees actually paid, not identities. This deters subsidy extraction by fake customers, not every form of collusion.
